tools.name: create_material
tools.description: Create a new Material asset with material expressions and connections.

blend_mode.description: Material blend mode: BLEND_Opaque, BLEND_Masked, BLEND_Translucent, BLEND_Additive, BLEND_Modulate.

shading_model.description: Material shading model: MSM_DefaultLit, MSM_Unlit, MSM_Subsurface.

id.description: Identifier for this node used in connections

type.description: Expression type: TextureSample, Constant, Constant3Vector, Color, Multiply, Lerp, LinearInterpolate, ScalarParameter, VectorParameter, TextureCoordinate, ParticleColor, or any UMaterialExpression subclass name

value.description: Value for Constant or ScalarParameter expressions

default_value.description: Default value for ScalarParameter (number) or VectorParameter / Constant3Vector (array of [R,G,B,A])

connect_to.description: Material property to connect to: BaseColor, Metallic, Specular, Roughness, EmissiveColor, Normal, Opacity, OpacityMask

output_name.description: Output pin name on this expression (e.g. 'Alpha' or 'Color' for ParticleColor)

connections.description: Optional list of connections between expressions or to material properties

from.description: ID, name, or type of source expression

from_output.description: Output pin name on source expression

to.description: ID, name, or type of target expression

to_input.description: Input pin name on target expression

to_property.description: Target material property (e.g. BaseColor, EmissiveColor, Opacity)

tools.name: create_material_instance
tools.description: Create a Material Instance from a parent material with parameter overrides.

asset_path.description: Content path for the new MI

parent_material.description: Content path of the parent Material

tools.name: add_material_expression
tools.description: Add an expression to a material. (Deprecated: use create_material instead).

tools.name: connect_material_property
tools.description: Connect an expression output to a material property. (Deprecated: use create_material instead).

tools.name: capture_material
tools.description: Render the material to a texture and capture a snapshot image to disk.

asset_path.description: Content path of the Material to capture.

max_dimension.description: Max width/height of the captured image.

tools.name: create_pbr_material_from_textures
tools.description: Create a PBR Material asset from texture maps (Base Color, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, AO, etc.) and auto-wire shader pins.

material_path.description: Destination package path for Material asset (e.g. '/Game/Materials/M_CharacterPBR')

normal_texture_path.description: Optional: Object path of Normal map texture

roughness_texture_path.description: Optional: Object path of Roughness map texture

metallic_texture_path.description: Optional: Object path of Metallic map texture

ao_texture_path.description: Optional: Object path of Ambient Occlusion texture

specular_texture_path.description: Optional: Object path of Specular texture

emissive_texture_path.description: Optional: Object path of Emissive texture

opacity_texture_path.description: Optional: Object path of Opacity texture
